# Issue #7: touching intervals are not merged

`merge_intervals([(1, 3), (3, 5)])` returns `[(1, 3), (3, 5)]` but the documented
behaviour is that closed intervals sharing an endpoint merge into `[(1, 5)]`.
Unsorted input must also be handled. Fix `ranges/merge.py`.


Repository files:
ranges/__init__.py
ranges/merge.py
tests/test_merge.py

arguments.summary: Fixed merge_intervals in ranges/merge.py by sorting input intervals prior to merging and changing the overlap condition from `start < last_end` to `start <= last_end` so that touching intervals sharing an endpoint merge properly.
